# AIBlockList

> Open-source behavioral trust and safety infrastructure for X and Threads. AIBlockList identifies and filters automated reply bots farming impressions and monetization, while protecting people who use AI responsibly in everyday work, translation, and accessibility. Let's use AI wisely.

AIBlockList never relies on probabilistic AI text detectors. Every classification requires repeatable behavioral signals (SIG-01 to SIG-05), canonical public post URLs, SHA-256 audit logging, and an independent public appeal process with live bio-token ownership verification.

## Core Pages

- [Live Registry & Intelligence Hub](https://aiblocklist.com/): Search and inspect indexed X and Threads accounts with public evidence URLs.
- [Account Reach & Health Checker](https://aiblocklist.com/account-health): Check if an account is indexed, flagged, or clear, with actionable remediation guidance.
- [Public Account Appeals](https://aiblocklist.com/appeals): Verify account ownership via a live bio token and submit a public appeal explaining responsible AI use and future operation.
- [Behavioral Methodology (SIG-01 to SIG-05)](https://aiblocklist.com/methodology): Deterministic behavioral verification rules and why AI text detectors are prohibited.
- [Transparency Ledger](https://aiblocklist.com/transparency): Real-time statistics and SHA-256 hash-chained audit logs.
- [About & Use AI Wisely Charter](https://aiblocklist.com/about): Project philosophy, lineage, and Apache 2.0 / ODC-By 1.0 governance.
- [Report Automated Spam](https://aiblocklist.com/report): Submit public evidence URLs for human review.
- [Browser Extension](https://aiblocklist.com/extension): Local-first warning badges for X and Threads feeds.

## API & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [REST API Documentation](https://aiblocklist.com/api-docs): Public JSON, CSV, and blocklist export endpoints.
- [Full LLM Reference](https://aiblocklist.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical and policy reference for AI assistants and search engines.
- [Sitemap](https://aiblocklist.com/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of public pages.
